nasm_x86_64_pure_syscall.title: NASM x86_64 Pure Syscall Banner
nasm_x86_64_pure_syscall.code:
global _start

section .text
_start:
    ; write(1, msg, len)
    mov rax, 1          ; sys_write
    mov rdi, 1          ; stdout
    mov rsi, msg        ; message pointer
    mov rdx, len        ; length
    syscall

    ; exit(0)
    mov rax, 60         ; sys_exit
    xor rdi, rdi        ; code 0
    syscall

section .data
msg db "AION NASM DOJO: Pure bare-metal syscall execution verified!", 10
len equ $ - msg
